INVARIANT SCDraw_Player_Mark
CONSTRAINT SCDraw_Player_Budget
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE

wrapper.name: SCDraw_Player
wrapper.text:
---- MODULE SCDraw_Player ----
EXTENDS Player
LOCAL INSTANCE Naturals
SCDraw_Player_TLC == INSTANCE TLC
SCDraw_Player_Budget == SCDraw_Player_TLC!TLCGet("distinct") <= 500
SCDraw_Player_Broken == (IF PanelOnlyWhilePlaying THEN {} ELSE {"PanelOnlyWhilePlaying"})
SCDraw_Player_Mark == IF SCDraw_Player_Broken = {} THEN TRUE ELSE SCDraw_Player_TLC!PrintT(<<"00000000000000000000000000000000", <<playback, panel>>, SCDraw_Player_Broken>>)
====
